title: Admira Thunderpussy wins Drag Race Sverige Season 1
summary: In the Grande Finale (SE-S01-E08), the judges crowned Admira Thunderpussy the winner of Drag Race Sverige's first season directly after the final challenge, with no lip sync for the crown. Fontana finished as runner-up and Vanity Vain placed third.

title: Almighty Aphroditey: Sweden's first Porkchop
summary: Almighty Aphroditey was the first contestant eliminated on Drag Race Sverige (SE-S01-E01), losing a lip sync to Daniela Rathana's "Puss & Kram" against Endigo.

title: Antonina Nutshell's Reading twist return
summary: Antonina Nutshell was eliminated in SE-S01-E02, but in SE-S01-E04 Robert Fux brought back the previously eliminated queens to compete in a Reading is Fundamental mini-challenge for a chance to re-enter. Antonina won the mini-challenge, returned to the competition, and then won that episode's lip sync against Imaa Queen before being eliminated for good in SE-S01-E06.
